Commentary.Commentary: Thus, 285 to win. There is a some sort of resemblance to the previous game. Australia should be confident of chasing this down like they did in the last match but it will come to how the pitch behaves as well as how the dew comes or does not. Shoaib Malik will know the bowlers will have to do better than last time to defend this total against Finch and co. Will they? Join us for the chase in a while...

The innings initially began poorly for Pakistan with Jhye Richardson picking up two early wickets. Two more fell against the run of play and it looked like Australia had the upper hand at the middle of the innings mark. Pakistan played it smartly post that, when the last recognized real batting pair of Malik and Rizwan added a solid partnership. Post that, when it was expected of them to end well, they fell and Australia would be happy that they are chasing less than 300. Coming to the bowling, the away side would be relieved that the injury to Jhye did not come back to haunt them and Aaron Finch bowling 10 overs for just 41 runs was a bonus and he got the wicket of Haris Sohail as well. The rest too did decently and did not ever allow the hosts to get too many.

This game has finished round about a total that the previous game had too. A little difference this time was that Pakistan will be really happy to have reached here after being 4 down for just a few runs over 100. A solid century partnership between Mohammad Rizwan and Shoaib Malik meant that they did have a launchpad to finish this innings off solidly. Rizwan reached his hundred and wanted to go on to make it a daddy hundred. That though did not exactly turn out to happen as the Aussies picked a few wickets at the end. Some lusty blows from Imad Wasim in the end meant that Pakistan at least got over 280.
Shorter and slower delivery on middle, Yasir goes for the pull but gets it off the inside edge and it goes to the keeper. No run on the last ball and PAKISTAN END WITH 284/7.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
FOUR! A six and now a four! Full toss outside off, Wasim connects on it well and drives it past a diving mid off for a boundary. 10 runs off 2 balls, Pakistan finishing strongly.
SIX! A length ball on middle, Wasim stands tall and tonks this one way over deep mid-wicket. Useful runs these coming off Imad's bat.

Short ball on the shoulders, Yasir pulls it but the ball takes the inside edge and goes straight into the ground. They go for the run and Stoinis runs hard and kicks the ball onto the stumps. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show Imad was well in.
Run out appeal taken upstairs... Imad Wasim though looks like he was in easily.
Full ball outside off, Imad goes for the heave but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg for a single.
Fuller one outside off, driven down to long off for a single by Wasim as he keeps strike.
FOUR! Good, smart batting! A short length ball outside off, Wasim upper cuts it over the backward point region for a boundary.
Yasir Shah is next to bat.

OUT! This time a half-volley gets the wicket! Coulter-Nile will consider himself lucky. A fuller length ball outside off, Ashraf looked to smash it over long on again but can only get it as far as Handscomb at long on. He is kicking himself as he goes off the field.
SIX! Faheem has picked the bones out of this one! A length ball outside off, he spreads his arm and smashes it over long on for a biggie!
A half-volley this time but Wasim cannot make use of it. The ball is mistimed as Imad looks to lift it over long on but manages only to hit it past the bowler with no power.
Yorker on middle, Feheem can only dig it out towards mid-wicket for a single. Excellent delivery!

Similar to the fourth ball but this time it's Ashraf. Bowls it full this time outside off, Ashraf goes the drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls to the covers and they steal a single.

Faheem takes off his helmet and a little bit to compose himself. He does look a little rattled by that and will also need to change the head gear as it's strap is broken. Some time to regain his bearings as well...

That's hit him hard! Ashraf goes to pull this short ball but is too early on that as the ball goes past his bat and hits him hard on the helmet. He looks to be fine but takes some time to recover. Change of helmet for him.
Bowls it in the block hole outside off, Imad goes for the drive but it hits the inside half of the bat and and hits his pads. They steal a run.
Another one full and wide outside off, this time Wasim throws his bat at it but fails to make any contact.
Short length ball on middle, Faheem mistimes his pull towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Outside off on a short length, Ashraf looks to cut the ball but fails to put bat on ball.
Marcus Stoinis to bowl the 48th over.
Full ball this time, Imad goes down the track but fails to connect on the one. The ball clips his pads and goes straight back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball pitching outside leg, Ashraf goes for the flick but is beaten by the pace of the ball. The ball hits his pads and goes to the fine leg region. One run taken. Leg bye signaled.
Imad Wasim is the next batsman.

OUT! After a long time, the third umpire rules the decision in the favour of the bowling team. The replays are inconclusive says the third umpire after watching many slow-mos. He then proceeds to say that there is no movement of the skirting in the replays that he sees and hence, rules it as out. A length ball on middle, Rizwan lifts it to long on where Maxwell leaps and takes a good catch. He realises he is too close to the rope and hence throws the ball up, goes outside and then comes back in to complete the catch. There is a need to check this by the umpires and they go upstairs showing the soft signal as out. The replays roll in and the third umpire too stays with the soft signal as there is no evidence to turn over the decision. Good job by the Big Show. Rizwan walks back after a really good knock.
The umpires have taken it upstairs, to check for a catch that Maxwell has taken on the boundary rope. He doesn't seem too confident though. The umpires have given the soft signal as out!
This time, Rizwan hits this fuller length ball towards mid off. Fails to find the gap and missed out on a half-volley.
FOUR! Two in two! A length ball on middle again, a kind of nothing length to bowl at this time. Rizwan pulls it away hard and beats a diving deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! A length ball on middle, Rizwan comes inside the line of the ball and scoops it through the right of the short fine leg for a boundary.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back on.
Tossed up on off, Ashraf gets a leading edge on that one but it falls just short of the cover fielder.

FOUR! LUCKY! Edged but above the first slip fielder! Ashraf goes for the reverse sweep on this short ball but gets a thick top edge which goes past the jumping slip fielder who misses to get hands on the ball. The ball goes to the fence.
Ashraf pushes this one to the covers.
Tossed up outside off, Rizwan goes for the sweep but gets hit on the pads. Lyon has a loud appeal and the keeper joins him. Replays show the ball was turning in and going down leg. One run scored.
Floated ball outside off, Faheem sweeps it to deep backward square leg and changes strikes.

Flatter on middle, Rizwan drops the ball towards cover and sets off for a quick run. Finch there reaches the ball really quickly and throws at the bowler's end but hits the batsman's bat. Could have been close had he hit the stumps.
Flighted once more outside off, Ashraf drives this but too close to the right of cover where the fielder runs and makes a stop, preventing any runs.
Flighted on middle, Faheem defends his first ball watchfully towards cover.
Faheem Ashraf is the new man in.

OUT! Malik holes out! A flatter one on middle, the skipper charges down the track and looks to hit it over long on but gets too close to the ball hence does not get the elevation. This time, Maxwell makes no mistake and holds on to the catch easily. A good knock from Shoaib but Pakistan needed him to be till the end as he is capable of getting quick runs.
Rizwan wants to go big but mistimes the ball straight to long off.
Pushed to the cover region by the skipper. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter and quicker outside off, punched by Rizwan coming down the track to deep cover for a single.
Floated ball outside off, Rizwan sweeps it to deep backward square leg and completes a single.
Bowls it shorter this time, Rizwan goes for the pull but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls to fine leg and the batsmen take a couple.
Flighted ball on off, Rizwan goes for the sweep and gets hit on the pads. Lyon appeals for an lbw. But the umpire denies as it was clearly outside off.
Tossed up on the pads, driven to long on for a single.
Rizwan dances down the track and plays it to the off side for a single.
Full length ball on middle, Malik plays it to mid-wicket where Maxwell misfields and concedes a single.
Safely pushed away to deep mid-wicket for a single. 8 runs off this over!

DROPPED and FOUR! A flatter ball on middle, Malik charges down the track and looks to go big over long on but he hits it flat. The ball carries to Maxwell out there who fails to hold on to the ball. What is worse for Australia, the ball goes to the rope as well.

Single and that is his hundred! His first one in ODIs! A flatter ball on middle, Rizwan sweeps it away to deep backward square leg for a run. It has been a brilliant knock from him so far but now he will look to start going big.
Oooh! Almost! A flatter one on middle, skids through after landing. Rizwan looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto the pads.
Short and quicker outside off, cut away by Rizwan. The ball goes through point for a couple, takes him to 99!
Flatter one on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Adam Zampa is back.
Another short length ball, Malik pulls it but straight to the fielder at leg gully.
Bowls it shorter this time, Malik guides it to third man for a brace.
Flighted ball on the leg stump line, Rizwan plays it to backward point for a single.

50 up for the Pakistani skipper! His 44th in the ODIs! He has steadied the ship here for Pakistan along with Rizwan. Can they continue and get Pakistan to 300? Gets there playing a full ball off his pads to the leg side and going for the single.
Bowls it on the the pads, Rizwan flicks it off his pads to the on side for a single.
Tossed up on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.

Oooh! That almost bowled him! A length ball, keeps a tad low and Rizwan with his high backlift wanted to drive that ball but failed to get down in time. The ball goes just past the off stump and to the keeper. Lucky!
Bowled at a slower pace outside off on a length, Rizwan is a little early into his drive and mistimes it to extra cover.
A length ball on top of middle, flicked away by Rizwan for a couple of runs towards mid-wicket. That is good running from the batsmen.
Short ball on middle, pulled away for a run by Malik to deep backward square leg.
Bouncer on middle, Shoiab Malik ducks under it and lets the ball go.
On a length and on middle, pushed back to long on for a run by Rizwan.
Wide! Stoinis delivers this down the leg side. Rizwan goes for the flick but fails to put bat on ball. It is wided by the umpire. That brings up the 100-run stand between these two!
Powerplay 3 time! A maximum of 5 fielders are now allowed outside the ring.
Shortish and on off, punched down to long on for one. 5 from the over. 211/4 at the 40-over mark!
Fires this one in on middle and leg, Malik gets back and tickles it to deep square leg for a run.
Lunges to a full ball and softly pushes it to backward point for a quick single.
Quicker and fuller on middle, turned off the pads to square leg for a single.
Flatter and a touch shorter on middle, Malik moves back and helps it to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery, full and on off, Rizwan leans forward and across before working it down to wide long on for a run.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Fullish and on off, pushed back to the bowler. Stoinis did well in his followthrough to stop the ball. Fine over, just three coming off it!
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for one.
Play and a miss! First sign of intent from Rizwan. He gives the charge to the bowler. Tries to swing a length ball over the leg side but misses and it goes right through him to the keeper.
A low full toss this time, around off, Malik forces it down to long on and picks up a single.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Rizwan flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
Full in length and on off, it's been pushed back to the bowler.
Marcus Stoinis is back on.
Flatter and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes wide of mid off and they cross.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Quietly eases it down to long on and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Maxwell cuts down on his length and goes short and wide outside off, Malik reaches out for it and slaps it through backward point for a boundary. 200 up for Pakistan!
Loopy and full on off, Malik tries to flick but gets a leading edge which rolls safely back to the bowler.

Drinks break. Pakistan have recovered well through this partnership between Rizwan and Malik. But still they are not out of the woods. This pair needs to continue and finish the innings well, unlike the last game. Australia are a bowler short but Aaron Finch has done well to fill in for the injured Jhye Richardson. They just need to maintain the same intensity and bowl well at the death.
A googly on off, Rizwan plays late and taps it down to short third man. Dot ball to end the over.
Fullish and on off, knocked down to long off for a run.
Strides forward to a full ball and strokes it to sweeper cover for one.
Quicker and flatter on off, skidding in off the surface, Rizwan moves back to punch it through the line but it takes the inside edge and rolls to mid-wicket.
Leans forward and pushes it to the right of the point fielder for one.
A tossed up ball landing full on off, Rizwan walks forward and drives it past the right side of the extra cover fielder for a single.
Full floated outside off, driven past the diving cover fielder for one.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Strides forward to a full ball and strokes it in the direction of mid on. Maxwell quickly reacts to cut it off.
Floated full ball on leg, it's flicked in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Well played in the end! Rizwan initially looks to go down on one knee and try to sweep but the line is wide outside off. Rizwan recovers well and glides it past short third man for a couple.
Glenn Maxwell is introduced into the attack.
Plays the paddle towards fine leg and another single results.
Leans into the stroke and hits it through covers for a run.
Plays this one late towards short third man for a run.
The googly, the batsman goes back and then punches it through covers for a single.
Good shot but only for a run. Rizwan dances down the track and then goes over covers. The sweeper does well to move to his left and keep it down to one.
Flatter and on the pads, Malik works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Adam Zampa is brought back into the attack.
A dot to end as the last ball is pushed back to the bowler. A good over though for Pakistan, 12 from it.
Malik also takes a single by flicking it through mid-wicket.
Already got 10 from the three balls, no need to take any risk, Rizwan does the smart thing by working it around the corner for a run.
Now a couple as Rizwan pulls this one through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is through square leg. Gets the sweep shot out and nails it. It is in the gap and another boundary. Only the third boundary conceded by the part-timer.
FOUR! In the gap! Finch gives it a lot of flight. Rizwan's eyes lit up. He goes for the slog sweep, hits it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
On the fuller side, the batsman hits it towards long on for another single.
Length and outside off, it is guided down to third man for a run.
Attacks the off pole and it is defended.
Full and on the pads, Rizwan works it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Nicely done, that! Short and outside off, Rizwan stands tall and slashes. It goes past point and into the fence.
Fuller in length on middle, Rizwan strokes it to mid on.
Another single as this is punched through the cover region.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They have run through for a single. 50-run stand comes up!
On the stumps, the batsman goes back and pushes it through covers for a run.
Rizwan goes back and then punches it through covers for another single.
Malik pushes it through covers with the turn for a run.
A full toss on off, this is hit down to long off for a single.
On a length around off, Malik flicks it on the leg side but picks the mid-wicket fielder. Fine over by NCN, just 4 from it.
A length ball on middle, Malik brings down a straight bat and pushes it back past the bowler. The mid on fielder moves across to his left to stop the ball.
Short in length and outside off, Rizwan stands tall inside the crease and deflects it down to third man for one.
Back of a length delivery on off, Malik punches it off his back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Shoaib covers the line and pushes it towards mid on.
Starts a new spell with a good length delivery on middle, Malik gets on top of the bounce and works it behind square leg for a brace.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back on.
A single to end another tidy over by Finch. This is pushed down to long on.
On off, Rizwan goes back and pushes it through covers for a run.
Another punch shot which finds the man at covers.
Fires it on off, Rizwan goes back and mistimes it to covers.
Down the leg side, it is worked through square leg for a single.
Floats it up on off, it is stroked down to long off for a run.
FOUR! That is very well placed! This is bowled quicker and slightly outside off. Malik waits for it, uses the width and then guides it past point, away from the sweeper and to the boundary.
Shortish and outside off, Rizwan slaps it through covers for a run.
Flatter and on middle, this is stroked down to long on for a run.
On the stumps, kept out.
A push through mid off sees the batsmen change ends.
Misfield! Malik moves away then punches it through covers. Nathan Coulter-Nile moves to his right but just at the very end, takes his eyes off the ball. A misfield and the batsmen run three.
Loopy and full on middle, worked in front of square leg for a run.
Short again, cut towards point where the fielder dived to make a partial stop. A single taken.
Fails to put it away! Short and wide outside off, Rizwan mistimes his cut to covers.
Loopy and full on middle, Rizwan drives but finds the cover fielder.
Stays back inside the crease and punches it down to long on for a run.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it in front of square leg for a run.

50 for Rizwan, he has really played nicely out there. Kept himself busy and has worked his way to a very attractive half ton. Needs to continue though. He gets there as he pulls this half-tracker by going down on one knee through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Another sweep from Rizwan and another boundary! Goes down on one knee and hits it through square leg, away from the fielder in the deep and a boundary.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
The slider on middle, Rizwan goes back and punches it to mid off.
Malik now takes a single as he eases it down to long off.
Fires it on the pads, the batter goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Adam Zampa is on now.
Eased through covers and Rizwan retains strike.
Flatter again on middle, Rizwan pushes it back to the bowler.
This is eased down to long on for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
On the stumps again, this is pushed to covers.
On the stumps, blocked.
A single to end as this is worked through mid-wicket.
BYE! A good ball though. On off and it skids through. Rizwan looks to punch it through the off side but misses. The keeper fails to gather it and a bye is taken.
Now does the right thing by going back and working it through mid-wicket for a run.

SIX! First of the game and it is off the bat of the Pakistan skipper. He steps down the track, stays inside the line of the ball and then lofts it over mid off. Would not have mattered though even if he was at the boundary also as it goes all the way.
Waits for the ball and then guides it through short third man and takes two.
The straighter line, Rizwan goes back and works it towards square leg for a quick run.
Shortish on off, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
A bit of an uppish off drive by Rizwan but well wide of the bowler. A single down to long off.
Edgy! Tossed up ball on off, skidding in, Rizwan under edges his attempted sweep shot onto the front leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Malik goes back and punches it down to long on for one.
Loopy and full on off, Malik drives it back off his front foot. Finch moves across to his left to stop the ball.
A single to end as Malik hits it down to long on.
Just outside off, Malik waits for it and then guides it to short third man.
Floats it on middle, Malik works it to mid-wicket.
Skipper Shoaib Malik walks in next at number 6.

OUT! In the air... taken! Akmal, who was looking nice and positive out there, has to walk back. The shortish leg side boundary might have tempted him there to take the aerial route. He looks to pull this short ball over the mid-wicket fence but it hits the higher part of the bat and lobs towards deep mid-wicket. Handscomb runs in and takes a neat catch. First one for Lyon and wickets at regular intervals keeping the Aussies on top here. Umar Akmal is absolutely gutted with himself, he knows these opportunities won't come easily to him.
Slightly short and outside off, Akmal cuts it but finds point. A little to his right or to his left and Akmal would have bagged a boundary.
Works it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
Goes back and guides this to point. Another dot to end another good over by Finch.
Gives it a little more air, Akmal finds the man at covers.
This time the single is taken as it is hit down to long off.

Confusion but safe! Rizwan goes for the sweep but mistimes it towards square leg. Akmal wants a run but Rizwan is not interested. UA now has to turn back. The fielder though misses his shy at the non-striker's end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A full toss and this is hit down to long on for a run.
A little too short, Akmal throws the kitchen sink at it but only manages an inside edge through mid-wicket for a run. 9 from Lyon's first over of his new spell.
On the stumps this time and it is defended.
FOUR! Short, wide and put away! This time there is a lot of width on offer. Akmal goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.

DEFT! Quicker and outside off, Akmal waits for it and then uses the pace of the bowler as he guides it through short third man. The fielder there gives it a chase and manages to pull it back. Two saved by him.
Flatter and on off, Rizwan punches it down to long off for a run.
A little short, Akmal goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Nathan Lyon is back into the attack now.
Fires it on the stumps, Rizwan blocks it out.
FOUR! Swept and swept very fine! Down the leg side, Rizwan says thank you very much as he hits it very fine down to the fine leg fence. 100 up for the hosts.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slightly short again and on off, UA cuts it again but finds point again. This time it is straight to him.
Well fielded! On the shorter side, Akmal guides it towards point. The fielder there dives and saves a run.
On the stumps, Akmal pushes it towards cover and wants a run but is sent back.
Goes quicker and flatter on off, it's on the shorter side as well, Umar moves back and strokes it in the direction of covers for one.
Fullish and on off, Akmal is on the front foot in defense.
Quicker one, full and on middle, blocked off the front foot.
Strides forward to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! That's a beautiful shot! Extra flight from Zampa to this delivery but it's too full and wide outside off. Akmal leans forward and plays a cracking square drive for a boundary.
Short in length and on off, Umar goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
He fires it on the pads, Akmal looks to play at it with a straight bat but misses to get hit on the pads. End of a successful over for the visitors.
Rizwan strokes it through mid off for a run.
Akmal is off the mark as he times it down to long off.
Umar Akmal walks in next.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! It is Finch who has provided the breakthrough. With all due respect to the Aussie skipper, he is probably the last bowler I thought who would get one of the two as they looked at ease out there. Also, the number which the Aussies consider unlucky (87) has worked in their favor here. It is the arm ball from Finch. It lands on off and angles away. Sohail plays inside the line and gets an outside edge. Carey takes it and appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Sohail walks in disappointment and rightly so. He is only Finch's third ODI wicket. The other two are Rohit Sharma and Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
This one is angled away from the batsman, Sohail pushes it to covers.
Drop and run! This is on the stumps, Rizwan pushes it towards cover and scampers to the other end.
A dot to end as Sohail keeps out the last ball.
Breaking news - Unfortunately it's a dislocated shoulder for Jhye Richardson, he certainly won't be back out there tonight, tweets Cricket Australia.
Rizwan takes another single as he hits it down to long off.

Flights it and lands it on middle, Sohail eases it down to long on for a run. 50-run stand up between the two. A vital one as the two joined association when Pakistan were in a little spot of bother. The job is only half done though.
The slider on off, Rizwan goes back and guides it through point for a single.
Very full this time, Rizwan jams it out to the bowler.
Zampa drops it short, Rizwan goes back and punches it to covers.

Drinks! Pakistan have managed to do well here after losing their openers early. Rizwan and Sohail are amidst a 48-run stand but they need to continue if Pakistan are to get to a good total here. Australia will hope they can break this stand as soon as possible.
On the stumps and it is defended. Tidy start by the Aussie skipper.
On the shorter side and on off, Rizwan goes back and flat-bats it to long on for another run.
Outside off, left alone.
Flatter and it is the straighter one on off, Rizwan pushes it to covers.
Works it with the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
Gives it nice amount of air, the batsman strokes it back to the bowler.
Aaron Finch brings himself on now.
Fuller on the pads, it is flicked through square leg for a run.
Slower and it is the googly outside off. Left alone.
Follows the boundary with a single as this is pushed through covers. Sensible batting.
FOUR! Swept and swept nicely! Goes down on one knee and then sweeps it by getting on top of the bounce. It is between the two fielders in the deep square leg region for a boundary.
The googly on middle, the batter blocks it out.
Rizwan dances down the track but Zampa bowls it short. Rizwan gets his pad in the way.
Punched off the back foot through covers for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball. Sohail eases it down to long off and gets to the other end.
Waits for the ball and then works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fires it on the pads, the batter goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Jhye Richardson is sitting in the dressing room with his right arm in a sling. He gives a thumbs up to the cameras. That's good to see.
Flatter and outside off, Rizwan goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
A single to end as the ball is driven to covers. Rizwan will retain strike. 4 singles from Zampa's first.
The slider on middle, Sohail goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
Gives it a nice loop on middle, the batter strokes it back to the bowler.
Rizwan gets into position early to play the paddle. Zampa fires it in but Rizwan still manages to play it towards fine leg for a run.
This time he hits it through mid on. The fielder is in the deep so a single.
Nicely tossed up around off, Sohail lunges and strokes it down to mid off.
Adam Zampa is into the attack.
Skidding in from around off, turned in the gap at mid-wicket for a run. 8 from the over!
A back foot punch to a shortish ball but he finds the cover-point fielder.
Shortish and on off, dragged down from the crease to long on for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! It's short and outside off, Sohail camps back and smacks it through point. Shaun Marsh in the deep tries his best but fails to cut it off.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and knocks it down to long on for a run.
A single to end a productive over for Pakistan. 9 from it as Rizwan pushes it through covers for a run.
Not a good sight this! Jhye is seen holding his right hand as he walks off the field. Let us hope it is not something serious.

FOUR! But a tremendous effort in the deep. Again it is slightly short and on off, Rizwan this time pulls it to the left of square leg. Jhye Richardson in the deep runs to that direction and then dives but fails to stop it. He straightaway puts one hand up and calls the physio out. He seems to be in pain.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.

FOUR! That went to the fence like a tracer bullet. The key there was Rizwan picked the length early. Slightly short and on middle, Rizwan crouches and then whacks it through square leg. The fielder in the deep was not far away but still he had no chance. 50 up for Pakistan.
This one is angled into the batsman, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
On a good length and around off, kept out.
Powerplay 2 begins! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be put outside the circle. Also, Marcus Stoinis returns into the attack.
FOUR! Spoils the over! Excellent use of the feet by Haris. Dances down the track and also makes room. Goes inside out, over covers and into the fence.
Sohail goes back and pushes it to covers.
This time it is flicked through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Flatter and turning back in, Rizwan goes back and works it to mid-wicket again.
Gives it nice flight and lands it on off, Rizwan with the turn works it to mid-wicket.
Works it with the angle through mid on for a run.
Nathan Lyon is on now.
On the shorter side, Sohail uses his wrists and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Another defensive stroke to the ball on off.
Drags his length back and this one is the seam-up ball. Blocked off the back foot.
Slower ball on off, the batter lunges and blocks it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish again and on off, Sohail once again finds mid off.
A dot to end as this is pushed to mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Slightly fuller this time and on off, Rizwan leans into it and times it through covers for a boundary.
A couple now as this is driven through covers.
On the fuller side, the batter strokes it to mid off.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Marcus Stoinis is the first bowling change.
On the pads, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Length and on off, it is defended.

Just short! This is certainly some plan against Rizwan. Second short one to him in the three balls he has faced. Rizwan though is ready to take on the challenge of pulling it. It however, falls just short of the fielder at square leg.
Fuller than the last ball and on off, it is kept out.
A confident shot on the first ball! Short and on off, Rizwan picks the length early and pulls it but to mid-wicket.
Interestingly, Mohammad Rizwan walks in at number 4. This is only the second time in his short ODI career that he is batting at this position. Good opportunity for him to show his game.

OUT! Leading edge and taken! Soft, soft dismissal there and now both the openers are back in the hut. Timely one for the Aussies as this partnership was looking good, Masood especially. Not a great delivery this though, it is shortish and around middle, sticks in the surface a little. Masood looks to play it with a closed-face bat but closes the face a touch early. It goes off the leading edge towards short mid-wicket where Marsh takes an easy catch. Second for Jhye and Pakistan in a spot of bother here.
Two dots to end but a good over for Pakistan. 9 from it. The last ball is guided towards point.
Loose shot! That was there to be hit! Full and wide outside off. Sohail throws his bat at it but away from his body. He gets an inside edge.
Bangs it short! Masood though has enough time to go back, get on top of the bounce and pull it towards deep square leg for a run.
Closer to the batsman this time and Masood plays it down onto the ground.

FOUR! Three in a row for Pakistan! Another poor ball, short and wide outside off. Masood once again waits for it and then cuts it square on the off side. It is in the gap so a boundary. Runs now coming thick and fast.

FOUR! Half volley and put away! Full and wide outside off, Masood just waits for it and then opens the face of the bat. Hits it through cover-point for a boundary. Consecutive boundaries for Pakistan.

FOUR! You do not need to run for those! What a shot! Richardson bowls it full this time and it is on off. Sohail shows the full face of the bat and strokes it past mid off. Ends the over with a boundary.
Goes for the surprise short ball. Sohail though is not surprised by it as he ducks under it with ease.
Hits it through the other side this time and gets runs! On the pads, Sohail shuffles across and works it through mid on for a couple.
On the shorter side again and for the third time in the over, Sohail hits it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Sohail stands tall and punches it but finds mid off again.
On the off stump, not letting the batsman free his arms. Sohail pushes it to mid off.
Mistimed! A little bit of width on offer outside off, Masood goes back to cut but gets an under edge. 10 from the over, 19 in the last two, Pakistan starting to find some momentum.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Bad line and length. It's on the pads and Masood clips it nicely through backward square leg. There is a fielder in the deep but he fails to cut it off.
Superb stop! Shortish and outside off, Masood rocks back to steer it past point but the fielder stationed there flies to his left and makes an excellent stop. Saves a certain boundary.
Wide! Loses his radar and slips a length ball down the leg side, Masood tries flicking but misses.

FOUR! Yet another cracking straight drive from a left-hander. This time Shan shows his class. On a length around off, Masood doesn't try to hit it hard and just caresses it down through mid off for a boundary.
Fine leg is up. Deep square leg in place.
Lands it up and around off, Masood drives but finds mid off.
Wide! Sprays it quite wide outside off, Masood shoulders arms. Kumar Dharmasena hesitantly exercises his arms.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it back.

FOUR! Even better! It's been thumped down the ground. This one is very full and in the line of the stumps, Sohail presents a straight bat and drives it delightfully past his partner for a boundary. Showing his good form.
FOUR! Well timed and placed! First boundary for Pakistan. A fractionally over-pitched ball outside off, Sohail once again doesn't move his front foot a lot as he drives it through covers.
Lazy, very lazy from Haris. Richardson angles across a good length delivery outside off. It further skids away from the batsman after landing. Sohail chases it away from his body and gets beaten.
On the 5th stump, Sohail shoulders arms to it.
Goes back to bowling on off and the batsman strokes it to mid off.
A run as this one is tucked off the pads towards square leg.
Good looking drive but again no runs! Length and on off, Sohail plants his front foot forward and pushes it to mid off. Two good overs for the Aussies to begin with.
On middle, Haris shuffles across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Stump-to-stump line and the batsman pushes it to mid on.
Pakistan are underway! Slightly shorter this time, it is nudged around the corner for a single.
Nice shot but for no runs! Length and around middle, the batter strokes it to mid on. That made a nice sound off the bat as it was right off the middle.
Excellent start by him too! Goes fuller and this one angles across. Masood plays inside the line, gets an outside edge which does not carry to the fielder at first slip.
Nathan Coulter-Nile to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
A wicket maiden to begin with by Jhye. Length again on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Haris Sohail is the new man in. Scored a century in the last one. Pakistan will like another performance like that.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Richardson draws first blood! His excellent start just gets better. He has been excellent with his line and length throughout the first over. Continues doing that as he lands this one on off and it is a touch fuller. This time though the ball shapes back in a little. Imam plays down the wrong line, he gets an inside edge and the ball uproots the off pole. He walks back without troubling the scorers. Not the start the hosts would have wanted after electing to bat.
Length again and on off again, Imam pushes it to mid off. 4 dots to begin with for Richardson.
Corrects his length this time and lands it on off, the batter defends it solidly.
A little too straight this time, Imam works it nicely but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Right on the money to begin with! On a length and around off, Imam goes back and defends it with a straight bat.
We're all set to get underway. Imam-ul-Haq and Shan Masood are the openers for Pakistan. Jhye Richardson to begin proceedings with the first new ball. A single slip in place. Let's play...

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, says he was not sure on what he wanted to do here but is happy chasing. Mentions the wicket did not change a lot in the last game and it was good to bat on. Further adds everybody has their own plans and they are executing it properly. Informs they are unchanged.

Pakistan skipper, Shoaib Malik, starts by saying that in the last match they got a good total but gives credit to the way Finch and Marsh batted. He reckons that his batsmen performed well but they need to do better with the ball. Informs Amir is out and Hasnain is in making his debut for Pakistan.
Toss - Pakistan win the toss for the second time in a row and they elect to bat first once again.

Another excellent performance from the Aussies in the first game saw them take a 1-0 lead in the series. They are starting to peak just at the right time with the World Cup not too far away. The visitors, however, would want to continue their winning run and go 2-0 up here. The hosts, on the other hand, will be eager to level the series as if they lose this one, it won't be easy getting back into it. Welcome to the coverage.
